verdicts.rationale: Different works: (a) 'Spatial Representation', a one-page Encyclopedia of Neuroscience entry (p.3807, DOI ...5553); (b) 'Spatial Representation in Cognitive Science and Film', a Projections journal article (vol 3, pp.24-52, DOI ...030103). Different titles, venues, page ranges, and DOIs.

Both are contributions to the same Disputatio 5(36) book symposium on Recanati's Mental Files, but (a) is Garcia-Carpintero's 'The Self File and Immunity to Error Through Misidentification' (pp.191-206) and (b) is Papineau's 'Comments on Recanati... Doubts about Indexicality' (pp.159-175). Different authors, titles, and page ranges; the shared DOI is a placeholder/error.
Same authors (Rieser & Poesio), 2009, same venue (SIGDIAL 2009), same pages 87-96. (b) merely appends the subtitle ': a PTT Model' to the identical paper.

Different works: (a) 'The Contents of Visual Experience' is Siegel's 2010 OUP book; (b) 'The Visual Experience of Causation' is a 2009 Philosophical Quarterly article (vol 59, pp.519-540). Same author but distinct title, type, venue, and DOI.
(a) has empty fields but its citekey is a typo variant (Sonneson) of (b) 'Pictorial concepts', Goran Sonesson 1989, Lund University Press. Same work.
(a) has empty fields; its citekey differs from (b) only by capitalization. (b) is 'Pictorial concepts', Sonesson 1989, Lund University Press. Same work.

(a) is the published 'A Uniform Theory of Conditionals' (J Philosophical Logic 43(6):1019-1064); (b) is 'A Uniform Theory of Conditionals (Chapter 3)', an unpublished manuscript that its own note identifies as the companion/dissertation chapter of exactly that article. Same underlying work.

(a) 'A Uniform Theory of Conditionals' vs (b) 'Conditionals, Meaning and Content: The Inquisitive Theory of If' are different papers by Starr; the shared DOI is an erroneous copy. Different titles and content.

(a) is the published 'A Uniform Theory of Conditionals' (JPL 43(6):1019-1064); (b) is 'A Uniform Theory of Conditionals (Chapter 3)', an unpublished manuscript whose note identifies it as the companion chapter to that exact JPL article. Same underlying work.

(a) 'A Uniform Theory of Conditionals (Chapter 3)' is the unpublished companion (note: companion to Starr 2014 JPL); (b) is 'A Uniform Theory of Conditionals', JPL 43(6):1019-1064 (same DOI, same volume/pages as the published article). Same Uniform Theory work.

Different works: (a) 'Targets uncrowd when they pop out' (Sayim, Westheimer & Herzog, Journal of Vision abstract, DOI 10.1167/...) vs (b) 'Visual Acuity and Hyperacuity' (Westheimer alone, Handbook of Optics 3rd ed chapter). Different titles, authors, venues; the shared ISBN is spurious cross-contamination.
Both are Richard Abel's 1994 'The Cine Goes to Town' (UC Press); (b) merely adds the subtitle 'French Cinema 1896-1914'. Same book.

Both are Schank & Abelson's 1977 'Scripts, Plans, Goals, and Understanding' (Lawrence Erlbaum, reissued by Taylor & Francis); (b) truncates the title to 'Scripts'. Same authors and year, same classic book.

Different works by Adams & Aizawa: (a) 'The Bounds of Cognition' is their 2007 Blackwell book; (b) 'Defending the Bounds of Cognition' is a 2010 chapter in 'The Extended Mind' (MIT Press, pp.67-80). Distinct titles, types, venues, and DOI.
Same authors (Agrawala & Stolte), 2001, SIGGRAPH, same pages 241-249. (b) appends the subtitle 'improving usability through generalization' to the identical paper.

Both are Albrecht's 'Universal Analytical GIS Operations' in Geographic Information Research (pp.577-592/591); (a) adds the subtitle and lists 1998, (b) lists 1997. Same chapter, minor year/pagination noise.

Both are the classic AGM paper 'On the Logic of Theory Change: Partial Meet Contraction and Revision Functions', Alchourron/Gardenfors/Makinson, 1985, J Symbolic Logic 50, pp.510-530. Same work (minor subtitle wording variation).

Different chapters in the same Oxford Handbook of Philosophy of Mind: (a) 'Thinking' by Antony (pp.607-630) vs (b) 'Information-Theoretic Semantics' by Dretske (pp.381-393). Different authors, titles, pages, and chapter DOIs; the shared book ISBN does not make them the same work.

(a) 'Thinking' is a single chapter by Antony; (b) 'The Oxford Handbook of Philosophy of Mind' is the whole edited volume (McLaughlin, Beckermann & Walter, eds). Chapter vs container book — distinct records despite the shared ISBN.
Both are Rudolf Arnheim's 1974 'Art and Visual Perception' (UC Press); (b) adds the subtitle 'A Psychology of the Creative Eye'. Same book.
